brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Vertical stack at q0,r0: piece:0,0,0;full (level 0) + piece:0,0,1;full (level 1) + piece:0,0,2;full (level 2) with snaps between levels. check_build meshClash clear.

Bottom storey (level 0) has notch drawer frame notch:0#0,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) in the notch cell q0,r1 against bases piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;half-w. This is the system's drawer implementation for level 0.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: Top storey (level 2) has open bin bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-full (hex-bin-full) on piece:0,0,2;full. It is an open-top bin, no cover.

finish.summary: Built a three-storey tower at 0,0 (levels 0-2) with a notch drawer frame on the bottom storey (level 0, notch at 0,1) and an open full bin on the top storey (level 2). Middle storey is structural. Mesh checked clear, joints locked and caps applied (4 optional cap faces remain open per check_build info only).

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
